topic: UploadThing replaced with self-hosted react-dropzone uploads
why: KJ image upload crashed with coerceError (unhandled rejection) — UPLOADTHING_SECRET/APP_ID were never set in .env.local, so the UT route handler failed to init
Phase 0 journal already flagged uploadthing as untested + 4 high npm-audit vulns in uploadthing/effect chain (issue #3)
Decision: remove external service entirely; no extra keys needed

architecture.flow: browser FileReader -> base64 data URL -> uploadImage server action -> stored directly in Event.imageUrl (plain String, mongoose)
architecture.server_action: lib/actions/upload.actions.ts uploadImage(dataUrl): Clerk auth() gate, validates data:<mime>;base64 format, MIME allowlist jpeg/png/webp/gif, 4MB cap computed as floor(base64len * 0.75), returns {url} or {url:'', error}
architecture.client: components/toptemp/FileUploader.tsx rewritten on react-dropzone (was already a dep, v14.3.8); props {onFieldChange, imageUrl}; preview + X remove button, drag-active/uploading states, inline error pill
architecture.form: components/toptemp/EventForm.tsx: useUploadThing/files/startUpload removed; onSubmit passes values.imageUrl directly
architecture.package_json_overrides: emptied to {} (effect/@effect/platform pins existed only for uploadthing vuln chain)

tradeoffs: base64 inflates ~33%; 4MB cap keeps Mongo docs reasonable
event-detail page has image fallback (commit 3999356); Next Image needs data: URLs handled — page uses fallback-capable render
future: could move to disk/S3 storage if image sizes grow
verify: npm run build passes; manual test: as KJ create event -> drag ~60KB image -> preview shows -> event saves with image
